body.name: unconditional effective total degree schedule
body.construction: Compute \(U_2(n)=2\cdot8^{2^{n(n+1)}}\), set \(B_2(n)=U_2(n)\), run \(DBI\) once through its complete internal weighted-degree loop at cutoff \(B_2(n)\), disable finite wall-clock timeouts, and retain the exact identifying formulas or the complete exact bounded-search certificate.
